title: Strawberry Cheesecake Pancake Bowl Pancakes, But No Flippin' Required!
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein s t raw berry cheesecake pancake bowl pancakes, but no flippin' required! this beautiful bowl delivers a divine cakey texture with a creamy, tangy twist - like cheesecake and pancakes had a dessert baby the ultimate meal-prep-friendly brekkie that you can heat and eat all week long. prep: 10 mins total: 25 mins 1 serving calories 15 pinch salt spray & cook qpflqngliqppjng; protein carbs fat fibre 30 g 47 g ingredients 50g oats 15g whey protein powder (vanilla) 1 whole egg 60g unsweetened almond milk 60g fat-free smooth cottage cheese 100g chopped strawberries 2g powdered sweetener* 1/2 tsp vanilla essence 1/2 tsp baking powder h tsp cinnamon instructions i.preheat the oven or air fryer to 1800c. ioog double cream greek yoghurt ioog chopped strawberries additional macros: (129c / plog / c12g / f5g / fibre 2g) 2. in a blender, add all ingredients except the strawberries and blend until smooth. 3. lightly spray an oven-safe bowl with cooking spray. 4. pour the batter into the bowl. 5.add the chopped strawberries on top. 6. bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the center is firm. (for a thick cake batter texture, bake for only 10-12 minutes.) 7. (optional) top with greek yoghurt and chopped strawberries. 8. serve and enjoy! no+es: from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: In a blender or mixing bowl, combine oats/flour, protein powder, egg whites, and baking powder.
Blend until a smooth, pourable batter forms. Let rest for 2 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly coat with cooking spray.
Pour 2-3 tablespoons of batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form on top (about 2 minutes), then flip and cook for another minute.
Stack high, drizzle with sugar-free syrup or honey, and serve warm!
